IF OBJECT_ID('EDS.TRY_FITRADES') IS NOT NULL
    DROP TABLE EDS.TRY_FITRADES

CREATE TABLE EDS.TRY_FITRADES
(
    [CIF_ID] [NVARCHAR](255) NULL,
    [COUNTERPARTY_ID] [NUMERIC](7) NULL,
    [COUNTERPARTY_NAME] [VARCHAR](255) NULL,
    [PRODUCT_DESCRIPTION] [VARCHAR](50) NULL,
    [REFERENCE_NO] [NUMERIC](7) NULL,
    [SETTLEMENT_DATE] [DATE] NULL,
    [FACE_VALUE] [NUMERIC](16,2) NULL,
    [INTEREST_RATE] [NUMERIC](10) NULL,
    [MATURITY_DATE] [DATE] NULL,
    [NEXT_COUPON_DATE] [DATE] NULL,
    [COST_PRICE] [NUMERIC](16,2) NULL,
    [MARKET_PRICE] [NUMERIC](16,2) NULL,
    [ACCRUED_INTEREST] [NUMERIC](16,2) NULL,
    [MARKET_VALUE] [NUMERIC](16,2) NULL,
    [CURRENCY] [VARCHAR](3) NULL,
    [ATTRIBUTE_NROSS_ACCOUNT] [NVARCHAR](20) NULL,
    [ATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_PHP] [NVARCHAR](15) NULL,
    [ATTRIBUTE_PDTC_NOCD_BPID_FCY] [NVARCHAR](15) NULL,
    [WEALTH_MANAGEMENT_TAGGING] [VARCHAR](40) NULL,
    [ASSIGNE_RM] [VARCHAR](30) NULL,
    [PRODUCT_SUBTYPE] [VARCHAR](30) NULL,
    [AS_OF_DATE] [DATE] NULL,
    [BNK_CODE] [NVARCHAR](20) NULL,
    [SOURCE_CODE] [NVARCHAR](20) NULL,
    [FILE_NAME] [VARCHAR](100) NULL,
    [insert_dttm] [DATETIME2](7) NULL
)

WITH (
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);
